A1.justification: Both PDFs describe CULTURE3D and support reliable comparison of all 11 pages, including text, figures, tables and references. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: v3 reports original reconstruction benchmarks on CULTURE3D, including quantitative metrics, runtimes and failures in Table 2 and qualitative results in Figure 4.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results in Section 4, Table 2 and Figure 4.

M1.justification: The collection and reconstruction pipeline in Section 3 and Figure 2 is unchanged, including COLMAP/Reality Capture processing and 3D asset generation.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the 20-scene CULTURE3D dataset with 41,006 images and the same five-scene quantitative reconstruction benchmark in Table 2.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains 3DGS, SuGaR, Wild Gaussian, GOF, HoGS and City GS. Figure 4 also retains the same qualitative comparators, including Reality Capture.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1–4.3 and Table 3 retain identical evaluation inputs, ground truth, metrics and experimental settings, including 30,000 total iterations and 15,000 SuGaR refinement iterations.

E4.justification: The failure-case analysis in Section 4.4 and qualitative comparisons in Figure 4 are unchanged. No ablations, sensitivity tests or additional robustness analyses are introduced.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, uncertainty bars or significance tests.

E6.justification: All metric values, runtimes and OOM/FAIL entries in Table 2 are identical. The qualitative reconstructions in Figure 4 and reported findings are also unchanged.

T1.justification: Neither version presents formal theoretical results, proofs or derivations. The explanations of evaluation metrics in Section 4.3 are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain identical claims about dataset scale and diversity, the data-generation pipeline and the reconstruction benchmark.

C2.justification: Sections 3.4, 4.4–4.5 and 5 retain the same interpretations and limitations concerning calibration, photometric inconsistencies, static-scene emphasis, memory demands and reconstruction difficulties.

D1.justification: Acquisition and processing details in Section 3 and hardware, software and hyperparameters in Table 3 are unchanged. Code/data release statements and access information are also unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, the dataset comparisons in Table 1 and all 54 reference entries are identical. No cited work or research positioning changes.

P1.justification: The first-page author contact changes from liuyzchina@gmail.com to liuyzchina@memories.ai, grouped with the other Memories.ai addresses. The arXiv version/date stamp is updated; the remaining prose and document structure are identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–4 and Tables 1–3 retain identical content, captions, formatting and placement. The page layout is preserved; visible differences are confined to the first-page contact and version text.

improvement.justification: v4 only updates an author email address and the arXiv version/date marking. Scientific content, empirical evidence, explanations and reproducibility information remain identical, so the administrative revision does not meaningfully change overall paper quality.
